changelog:
Initial release — generate Python scripts compatible with Alibaba Cloud RunScript/MCP Core sandbox.

- Converts natural-language Alibaba Cloud requests into RunScript-compatible Python scripts using only approved APIs and modules.
- Scripts rely exclusively on the injected call_cli function; prohibits use of SDKs, direct HTTP calls, or unapproved imports.
- Validates output scripts against the local sandbox checker (check_sandbox.py) to enforce security and compatibility rules.
- Produces only script bodies as output, with no Markdown or explanations unless requested.
- Designed specifically for RunScript/MCP Core/Sandbox-style automation; not for generating standard SDK-based project code.
summary: Generate Alibaba Cloud MCP Core RunScript-compatible Python scripts from natural-language cloud operation requests. Use when the user explicitly asks for Run...
